scope: Preserve binary64 values when adapting numeric DXF ARCALIGNEDTEXT groups 41-46 into DWG D2T text-backed fields, preserve the encoder's fallback D2T string, and keep retained-byte admission sufficient for every finite double spelling.

sourceEvidence.title: LibreDWG ARCALIGNEDTEXT field map
sourceEvidence.observation: The ARCALIGNEDTEXT map identifies fields 41-46 as D2T and maps them to DXF groups 41-46.

sourceEvidence.title: LibreDWG BITCODE_D2T definition
sourceEvidence.observation: BITCODE_D2T is defined as a text string. The public source defines the carrier type and mapping, not a six-significant-digit precision rule.

inference: DXF numeric groups are parsed as binary64 values. Since D2T is a text carrier and the reviewed mapping supplies no lossy decimal precision requirement, max_digits10 formatting is used to preserve the parsed finite binary64 value. This is a local precision-preservation choice, not a claim about native ARCALIGNEDTEXT rendering.

changes: arcAlignedD2T now uses DxfNumeric::formatDouble's max_digits10 default instead of six significant digits; the same helper is used for DXF-read D2T adaptation and DWG fallback text emission.
The parser's transient D2T bound is 24 bytes: max_digits10 digits plus sign, decimal point, and signed three-digit exponent.

The existing fast numeric test covers all six DXF D2T groups with adjacent representable doubles and a negative maximum-finite value. A 47-byte retained budget refuses the 24-byte value atomically; retry with 48 bytes succeeds and retains exactly 24 bytes.
A direct AC1027 DWG string-stream control encodes an empty D2T field from height=nextafter(2,3), reads the emitted TU using the version-configured text codec, and confirms exact binary64 recovery.
implementation.fixturePolicy: All inputs are generated in memory. No DWG or DXF fixture is added.

claimBoundary: The controls verify numeric field adaptation and a directly encoded DWG TU string; they do not verify a full physical DWG-to-DXF-to-DWG cycle.
No independent CAD producer/reader, native ARCALIGNEDTEXT rendering, platform behavior, or broader annotation support is qualified.
Raw/typed ERANGE policy remains open. Do not promote DWG/DXF, FreeCAD, LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, or ARCALIGNEDTEXT support claims from this receipt.
